answer_1.quote: In this work, we further explore the capability of LLMs/VLMs to demonstrate human-like characteristics in a range of psycholinguistic perceptual tests investigating 3 main areas of sound symbolism: (1) Shape Symbolism... (2) Magnitude Symbolism... and (3) Iconicity Rating...
datasets: 14k+ English words iconicity dataset by Winter et al. (2023)
answer_1.outputs: pseudoword choices, iconicity ratings, soundscape descriptions, onomatopoeia

answer_2.quote: Correlations between each LLM and human judgements are presented in Table... Spearman/Pearson correlations of .379 and .381, respectively.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 10 human evaluators with native-level English proficiency via internal methods... and presented an analogous task to that which we present to the VLMs.
answer_4.guideline: For the soundscape description task, human evaluators rated the visual description, soundscape description, and onomatopoeia on a 1-5 scale, where 1 = very bad, and 5 = excellent.
